info.title: CICIDS2017 Official Flow Feature CSV Files
info.subtitle: Official CICIDS2017 CICFlowMeter-generated flow-feature CSV files for intrusion
info.description:
This dataset is a mirrored distribution of the official CICIDS2017 dataset provided by the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC), University of New Brunswick (UNB), Canada, for academic and research purposes.

The uploaded files correspond to the official MachineLearningCSV version of CICIDS2017, which contains CICFlowMeter-generated network flow features extracted from real-world network traffic captures. The dataset includes both benign traffic and multiple categories of cyber-attacks collected over different working days.

The original dataset and ownership belong entirely to the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC), University of New Brunswick. This upload is intended solely for educational and non-commercial research use in the fields of network intrusion detection, cybersecurity, machine learning, and deep learning.

No additional preprocessing, normalization, balancing, feature selection, or modification has been applied to the files before upload.

The original CICIDS2017 dataset was created and released by the Canadian Institute for Cybersecurity (CIC), University of New Brunswick (UNB), Canada. The dataset was obtained from the official CIC dataset repository and mirrored here for academic and research purposes only.
